statement: Let q : Y → C be a projective flat morphism from a normal complex threefold to a smooth pointed curve (C, 0). Let H be a reduced divisor with horizontal prime components. Assume that the Cartier fiber Y0 = P S is reduced, that (Y, Y0 + H) is dlt, and that its boundary components are Q-Cartier. Assume also that Yt \ H is smooth for all sufficiently small t ̸= 0. For each component S of Y0, let BS be the reduced union of its intersections with the other components of Y0 + H, and put S◦ = S \ BS. If each local smoothing of an isolated singularity in S◦ has Milnor fiber Euler characteristic at least one, then χc(Yt \ H) = X S⊂Y0 χc(S◦ ) + δ, δ ≥ 0, (6) for all sufficiently small t ̸= 0.
